```{r, include=FALSE}
task <- "tpaired2"
source("tpaired.R")
```

Question
========
An explorative study investigates the effect of one-on-one tutoring on school grades of pupils.
A total of $N=`r N`$ pupils receives a 16-weeks intervention. The primary outcome is 
the difference in Grade Point Average measured before and after the intervention 
(GPA from 0 = worst to 4 = best).The significance level is set to $\alpha=.05$ one-tailed.

````{r, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(tab, caption="_Table 1._ GPA scores at T0, EOT, and D=EOT−T0")
````
Does one-on-one tutoring lead to a meaningful improvement (i.e., more than $\mu_0=`r mu_0`$ units increase) in GPA?
Please report the one-tailed $p$-value.

```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Solution
========
The $t$-statistic for paired samples is given by $t=\frac{\overline{D}-\mu_0}{\sigma / \sqrt{N}}$. 
The one-tailed $p$-value is then given by looking up $P\left(T \leq -\lvert t\rvert \,;\, N - 1 \text{ df}\right)$

```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```
